The ISR can change v_tundra between the argument read and the read in fn_dune, so the two reads are inconsistent.

The ISR can overwrite the value the task just wrote before the task copies it to v_harbor.
The ISR can change v_tundra between the read that copies it to v_harbor and the later read at line 24, so the two reads disagree.
